name: How long does stair rail installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does stair rail installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stair rail installation varies depending on the complexity of the design, the materials chosen, and the size of the staircase. A simple replacement of an existing rail might take one to two days, while a completely new custom installation with intricate balusters or newel posts could extend to several days or even a week. We provide a detailed project timeline after assessing the specific requirements of your home's staircase and your desired railing style.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from a few days to over a week, depending on design complexity, materials, and staircase size.
